purpose: Cross-check a single OSAP identifier against a retrospective dated firm-name release; not a universe or return study
read_method: HTTP range reads of archive metadata and firm_names.parquet; full ZIP was not downloaded
match: one matching PERMNO row with a name consistent with IBM and a spell covering both months
limits: The release states its firm-name data derives from licensed CRSP data; a separate IBM mapping may share the same upstream source and is not necessarily independent.
Name consistency does not itself prove SEC CIK or share-class identity; inspect filings and another independent linkage.
The 2026 release and dates are retrospective, not proof of availability at either 2024 decision time.
Provider says use requires no entitlement; research-use and redistribution terms and underlying rights were not independently assessed.
No name-table file, stock rankings or returns were saved.
Archive components were read in separate HTTP requests; no immutable release hash or atomic snapshot was established.
